font.reason: Neutral variable UI sans suited to academic research cards; reliable Persian glyph coverage, natural shaping, and variable weights preserve the restrained SF/Arial-like source tone.

rtlDecisions.action: Translated into concise, idiomatic Persian with appropriate technical vocabulary and Persian punctuation.
rtlDecisions.why: These are the central readable content and should convey the same research-document volume in the target language.

rtlDecisions.what: Card text alignment and content anchoring
rtlDecisions.action: Set card direction to RTL; anchor title and author metadata at the right with logical-space placement.
rtlDecisions.why: Reading starts from the right in Persian and the text should align naturally within each paper card.

rtlDecisions.action: Moved the rail from the left edge to the right edge.
rtlDecisions.why: It serves as a leading edge accent beside the card content, so it follows the reading start.

rtlDecisions.what: Horizontal drift of the stacking stream
rtlDecisions.action: Negated the x displacement; the stack now drifts left while retaining the original down movement.
rtlDecisions.why: The source's rightward component expresses the flow direction of incoming content and mirrors for RTL. Vertical stacking is physical and remains downward.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the center anchor and symmetric card dimensions unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The composition is centered; mirroring only the horizontal drift preserves its balance.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept its downward translation and spacing unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The grid is a physical speed reference tied to the vertical card drift, not a reading-direction cue.

rtlDecisions.action: Preserved 144-frame duration, 12-frame cadence, 6-frame entry, easing, squash, deterministic skeleton widths, blur, brightness and opacity curves.
rtlDecisions.why: These define the source's throughput rhythm and research-stack depth; none depend on language direction.

rtlDecisions.action: Localized the labels and used Persian digits for generated synthetic identifiers.
rtlDecisions.why: The metadata is visible UI copy; Persian digits follow the project localization rule.

rtlDecisions.action: No raster assets are used; the grid and skeleton bars are native CSS shapes.
rtlDecisions.why: There is no baked-in foreign text requiring replacement or blur.

visualVerification.notes: Viewed matching Persian and original PNGs at entry (5), the mid-stack reading state (60), and the final beat (143), plus rendered stills across the full timeline. Persian glyphs shaped correctly; title and metadata remain within the card; the entry and stack progression preserve the source beat and depth feel.

concerns: The source prompt intentionally ends mid-flow: at 144 frames its 13th card is still entering. This source behavior is preserved.

rasterHandling: No raster images or baked-in text occur in this composition.
